description: Despite its ultra-compact design, the sleek, slim and light Super Skinny bi-fold wallet from Big Skinny can carry all that you need in your day-to-day life -- up to 30 full-size plastic cards plus space for cash. It features four card pockets (which includes one hidden pocket), an ID pocket with a clear plastic window for easy access to your driver's license or work badge and a full-size, extra-tall billfold area. The extra-wide pockets are lined with a rubbery coating to prevent cards from slipping out. Designed with rounded corners for comfort, it's constructed of a lightweight, water resistant nylon microfiber material that is 5 to 7 times thinner and lighter than leather. It's machine washable for easy care and it dries out in about 20 minutes. The Super Skinny wallet measures 5-1/8 x 3-5/8 Inch (and 4 mm thin when empty). The first Big Skinny wallet was designed by Kiril Stefan Alexandrov (the company's founder) because he loathed sitting on a thick, heavy leather wallet. Since creating the original Sport Wallet in 2005 using an advanced nylon micro-fiber material (5 to 7 times thinner than leather), Big Skinny has added dozens of slim wallet styles for men and women with more on the way.

features: 1x 6"(L) x 3.75"(H) interior slip pocket, w/ hook and loop security flap

The new Maxpedition #0229 SPARTAN Wallet replaces our "over-engineered" PUG Wallet design. The evolution was a result of popular demand for our general purpose wallet design WITHOUT the bulky zippered coin purse that made pocket carry difficult. Our customers were right; this simplification makes for a much better yet less expensive wallet. recommendations.title: Coraline Glow-in-the-Dark House Zip Around Wallet
features: Loungefly Laika Coraline Glow-in-the-Dark House Zip Around Wallet
description: Cute as a button! Find a potential forever home brought to life on this Loungefly Laika Coraline House Zip Around Wallet. The Pink Palace Apartments have been transformed in colorful detail. Appliques, debossing, and printed underlayers make the architectural features pop, and in the dark, the windows glow. A full-button moon, which also glows in the dark, forecasts an ominous future. In front, the applique embossed black cat perches on the sign for the Pink Palace Apartments. On the back, you’ll find Coraline, in printed detail, before the steps of this magical house. Inside the wallet, you’ll discover 4 slots for holding cards and 1 clear slot for holding your ID. It’s the perfect accessory for wandering through secret passages—or for turning everyday activities into magical adventures. The Loungefly Laika Coraline House Zip Around Wallet is made of vegan leather (polyurethane). Wallet zips closed, has sturdy shiny gold-colored metal hardware, and features printed, applique, embossed, debossed, and glow-in-the-dark details. Take note of the coordinating pattern of the inside lining fabric. This wallet is an officially licensed Laika product. Wallet Dimensions: 6”W x 4”H (Please note: width is measured across the bottom of the wallet.)
